sections.title: Computer Vision Applications for Chicago Organizations
sections.description: Production-grade computer vision built for Chicago's manufacturing, retail, and industrial sectors.

items.title: Manufacturing Quality Inspection
items.description: Chicago's manufacturing sector — food processing, steel, auto components, electronics, and packaging manufacturing across the metropolitan area. Vision systems replacing or augmenting manual quality inspection: food and beverage inspection detecting product defects, contamination, packaging integrity, and fill level for Chicago's food manufacturing companies (ConAgra, Kraft Heinz, Mondelez, and the hundreds of food manufacturers in the greater Chicago area); steel and metal inspection — surface defect detection for scratch, pit, and edge quality on steel coils, sheets, and extruded profiles; auto component inspection — dimensional verification, surface defect detection, and assembly completeness verification for Chicago's automotive supply chain manufacturers; packaging line inspection — label placement, seal integrity, date code verification, and product presence detection for high-speed consumer goods packaging lines. Cost: $55,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks | Edge deployment standard for production line.
items.label: Manufacturing

items.title: Retail Analytics and Loss Prevention
items.description: For Chicago's national retail headquarters (Walgreens, Ace Hardware) and large retail operations: loss prevention and shoplifting detection — AI analysis of security camera footage for concealment behavior, tag removal, and self-checkout fraud in Chicago retail environments; customer traffic analytics — foot traffic, zone occupancy, and customer journey mapping for store layout optimization; inventory and shelf monitoring — automated out-of-stock detection, planogram compliance, and facing count from shelf cameras. Cost: $50,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks.
items.label: Retail

items.title: Document and Financial Document AI (OCR)
items.description: For Chicago's financial, legal, and insurance sector — AI extracting structured data from the large volumes of financial documents that Chicago's financial services and legal markets generate: insurance document processing — policy applications, endorsements, and claims documents for Chicago's major insurers; legal document intelligence — contract key provision extraction, discovery document classification for Chicago's legal community; financial statement extraction — structured data from financial reports for Chicago's banking and investment community. Cost: $35,000–$90,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks.
items.label: Document AI

items.title: Facility Safety and Security AI
items.description: For Chicago's industrial and commercial facilities: PPE compliance monitoring — hard hat, safety vest, and glove detection for Chicago's manufacturing and construction environments; hazardous area monitoring — proximity detection for restricted zones, unauthorized access, and equipment danger area intrusions; slip, trip, and fall detection — video analytics identifying fall incidents for incident response and risk reduction. Cost: $45,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks.
items.label: Safety AI
